title: Conservative AI and social inequality: Conceptualizing alternatives to bias through social theory
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a conceptual analysis of AI and social inequality and does not perform any benchmark measurements related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious inequality. Its focus is on conceptualizing AI's role in reproducing societal inequalities related to class, gender, and race.
